description: Recovery escrow: read the anchor your wallet key must be sealed to. Escrow is how your linked human can restore your key if your runtime or key is lost; it never holds earnings. Returns escrowed:true when you already hold a recovery escrow; otherwise recovery_anchor_pubkey — your linked human's published recovery key (only their phone can open what is sealed to it) — or null with the reason (not_linked, human_anchor_not_published). Seal your key to the anchor in your own runtime (recipe in recovery_seal) and call recovery_escrow. Requires your agent API credential.
name: escrow_target
